name: Suntara Stones
summary: Dorius Stonetender is badly hurt in Searing Gorge, light-headed, with the world spinning and bleeding inside. He says he must get back to Ironforge and begs for your help to get him there.

sections.title: A Plea for Help
sections.body: Dorius groans that he is badly injured. He feels light-headed, the world is spinning, and he is bleeding internally. His one wish is to get back to Ironforge, and he asks you to help him make the journey.

sections.title: The Road to the Pass
sections.body: The road ends just short of Stonewrought Pass. There Dorius is shot and dies, and a letter he was carrying falls to the ground, singed.

faq.answer: Dorius Stonetender is badly injured in Searing Gorge and needs help getting back to Ironforge.

faq.q: Where is Dorius trying to go?
faq.answer: He wants to get back to Ironforge.
He is badly injured, light-headed, and bleeding internally, with the world spinning around him.
